title: Filing: SK Hynix will become Kioxia's largest shareholder with a ~14.1% stake after it converts Kioxia bonds into shares, expanding its clout in the NAND sector (Yoolim Lee/Bloomberg)
summary: Yoolim Lee / Bloomberg: Filing: SK Hynix will become Kioxia's largest shareholder with a ~14.1% stake after it converts Kioxia bonds into shares, expanding its clout in the NAND sector — SK Hynix Inc. will become rival Kioxia Holdings Corp.'s largest shareholder, expanding its clout in the memory chip sector that's now critical to global AI development.
